This is a Boss Practice fight: you start directly against Cirno's spellcard
"Ice Sign 「No miss!icicle homing missile」" on Normal. Her health bar is at
the top of the field; deplete it to clear the phase. The missiles chase you,
so keep moving; this mode gives you a single hit: any bullet or body contact
ends the attempt.
